retryAfterMs.description: When present, the earliest useful retry in milliseconds (a TRANSIENT refusal such as CHAT_UNAVAILABLE). Absent when the Engine does not know.

reason.description: A chat refusal's reason (Spec A step 9): why this one request was not admitted. Present only on chat refusals.

forceAllowed.description: On a chat refusal: true when the app may offer the person a load in spite of it (POST /api/chat/load-anyway). Never true for an agent.
